overview: Generic energy materials should read through a dominant color family, a controlled view-dependent edge, and limited supporting breakup rather than complex surface realism.
common_failure_modes: using every lane at once with no clear energy read
opaque center killing the emissive-led look
capture_review_checklist: Front shot keeps a single dominant energy color.
Three-quarter shot shows breakup supporting the read rather than replacing it.
Grazing shot strengthens edge readability without clipping the frame.
